title: Skeptic Carl Pflock's only visit to the crash site
summary: Scott Ramsay tells of Skeptic Carl Pflock's only visit to the crash site, about unspecified at New Mexico (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The only skeptic that has ever been here was Carl Flock. That's because I drove him out here and walked him around and he lived two hours away.

plain: A man named Scott Ramsay, who has long studied a reported UFO crash at Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that only one skeptic has ever visited the site. He says that was Carl Pflock, a doubter of the story, and that Pflock only came because Ramsay drove him out and walked him around, even though Pflock lived just two hours away. Ramsay tells it to say that those who dismiss the crash have barely looked at the place.
